title: See the patient's record, history or account from the appointment
summary: From the appointment menu: clinical history, images, account statement, appointment history and details.

steps.title: Menu → Appointments
steps.details: The calendar shows appointments by room and doctor.

steps.title: Right-click the appointment
steps.details: The appointment menu opens. If you don't see it, change the day with the arrows or use Find appointment.

steps.title: Choose what to view
steps.details: Account statement (what they owe and paid), Clinical history, Images and files, Appointment history and Patient details.
